I saved the draft mail to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansley 2027 rate". It gives the Tansley Parcel proposed 2027 rate of $1,313 per seat, says the figure came from Pree's call with the customer, and notes that June approved sharing it. It's only a draft, so nothing has been sent.

I took June's approval as covering Pree's request, since that's the one she referred to. I've replied to June in our DM to confirm. I also told her that Ilse Varga's separate request from yesterday, for a mail to Tobias with the same rate, is still on hold, and asked whether her approval covers that one too.
